propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs AcliClient transport without validating that JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN credentials are present, allowing unconfigured environments to build a doomed backend that fails only at first API call

Jira Cloud authentication requires the account email as the username in Basic-auth, but _build_jira_backend does not validate that JIRA_USER is an email, allowing bare handles to silently 401 at runtime

_build_jira_backend must raise BackendEnvError at construction time (before AcliClient instantiation) when any of JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN are empty or whitespace-only, naming each missing variable and documenting the anonymous-access consequence
_build_jira_backend must validate JIRA_USER contains @ with non-empty local and domain parts (rejecting bare handles) and raise BackendEnvError naming JIRA_USER and the email requirement if invalid

test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly must flip from pinning silent-build behavior to asserting loud failure, achieving parity with DC's test_dc_pat_required_heldout.py
test_the_cloud_factory_also_asserts_conformance must use valid email credentials in its fixture so the credential guard passes before the conformance assertion is tested
